svg.title: Linch runtime shape: host, optional worker, headless kernel, Postgres
svg.desc: The host service enqueues runs to PgQueuer or runs an agent embedded. The worker claims a run lease in PostgresRunStore and drives the Agent. Inside the kernel the Agent owns a Session, which feeds the run loop; the loop calls providers, the scheduler and the turn_stopping guard. The Session writes messages to PostgresSessionStore, the loop checkpoints to PostgresRunStore, which appends run_events that the API reads back with load_events.
